captions: Prespecified plurality racial-assignment sensitivity on the fixed full-SJ available-2019 roster, using unchanged origin masks, saved income bins and equal or saved matched-visit venue weights.

Category indices use 0.1 index-point display bins (fractionalization multiplied by 100). Correlations use 0.01 bins. National information-loss fractions use 0.1 percentage-point bins. Decimal half-even rounding is applied to the round-trip decimal representation of the accepted binary64 values.

Each displayed change is a conservative interval derived only from its two displayed endpoint bins, in label-minus-mixture order. No independently rounded private difference or additional sign label is disclosed. Full-precision signed differences remain private; an interval containing zero does not establish an exact zero, disappearance or equivalence.

All 150 category labels and both weights remain. The correlation family uses the same fixed 136 labels throughout. Support failures withhold numbers; constant vectors remain undefined. Neither category intersections nor eligibility rules adapt to observed differences.

National tie, below-half and gap-at-most-five-percentage-points fractions average within-venue jointly classified origin-flow fractions over the entire SJ roster. They are not pooled origin counts, visitor traits, misclassification rates, error bounds or new eligibility screens. The flags overlap.

Primary and reverse rules use opposite exact-maximum tie priorities on the same once-normalized racial vectors; near ties are not merged. Reassignment discards within-origin racial shares. Income remains an area label based on median household income, with four race groups versus ten income bins.

This is sensitivity to the specified lossy reassignment. Mixed and unchanged patterns retain their meaning; no general representation-bias, actual-contact, individual-trait or causal conclusion follows. Common-geography, stable-ID and historical-production limitations remain.
Candidate for cumulative disclosure review only. No upload, publication, changed data licence or general release is authorized by staging.
